st.settings.general.smart_paste: Chat apps: the picture, then the note
st.settings.general.smart_paste.detail: A card dragged into a chat app drops its picture, then its note is pasted. Needs Accessibility.
st.settings.general.smart_paste.hint: Browsers, Claude, ChatGPT, Slack, Feishu, WeChat and other chat apps keep only the picture when a drop or a paste has one. With this on, a card dragged into them drops its picture and then Blurt pastes the note into the same message box; and for 2 minutes after you click (copy) a card, Ctrl+V there pastes the picture and then the note — for several cards, each picture then its note — and the copy stays on the clipboard for the next Ctrl+V. Notes, Mail, TextEdit and the like take both in one go; terminals and the File Explorer are left as they are. Needs Accessibility.
